create_rollout_dataset: create a rollout dataset by specifying checkpoint id, dataset name, sampler, rollout length and repeats
run_greedy_rollout: run greedy rollout on a model checkpoint to generate responses for test and training prompts
run_probability_rollout: run probability-based rollout on a model checkpoint to sample responses from predicted token distributions
drop_rollout_dataset: drop a rollout dataset from MongoDB by its dataset id
summarize_rollout_worker: summarize the RolloutWorker class that loads a model checkpoint and generates rollouts from tokenized traces
